title: Design: a matrix row's menu and the Delete matrix question
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open matrix A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens with Duplicate and a red Delete, as in picture 3.26.

Step 3:

  • A dialog titled "Delete" matrix A's name "?" reads matrix A's name "prices" category A's name ". Once it's deleted, it uses the General Matrix."
  • It ends with "Parts already on work orders keep their prices." and Cancel (white) and Delete (red), as in picture 3.29.
